items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: which the Peter Herbolzheimer Band in Germany does that

ctx.x: Yes I have. And in fact we’ve been rehearsing recently where the trumpets are facing this way, the trombones are facing this way, and the saxes facing the trumpets, just so that you can do it. I’ve also set them up where the trombones are in front, trumpets in the middle and the saxes in the back, which the Peter Herbolzheimer Band in Germany does that. So they have the saxes on a riser.
Is it hard to teach piano players and guitarists especially, what to do in a big band?
